scope: Seven buffer-intersection feats plus the exact Lifeleech dependency of Soul Cage; not the entire335-feat catalog.

sourceObject.name: Chef
sourceObject.effect: You can cook special food during a long rest that provides temporary hit points to your party.

sourceObject.name: Inspiring Leader
sourceObject.description: You can inspire others through stirring words.
sourceObject.effect: You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, giving them temporary hit points.

sourceObject.name: Empowered Summoning
sourceObject.description: A charismatic summoner calls allies with increased health and damage.
sourceObject.effect: Creatures you summon gain temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus and add your proficiency bonus to the first damage roll they make each round.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceObject.name: Field Medic
sourceObject.description: Trained medical care stabilizes allies faster during combat.
sourceObject.effect: You may use a healer’s kit as a bonus action. When you stabilize a creature, it gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceObject.name: Blood Ritual
sourceObject.description: Under the moon's gaze you bind flesh to curse through rites older than the cities of Aethel. Prestige lineage: Mooncursed. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: Once per long rest, as part of a 10-minute ritual using your blood, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level and advantage on the next saving throw against curse or disease effects. Required for many lycanthropic oaths. Allies who witness the ritual and share a drop of blood gain half your temporary hit points (rounded down) for 1 hour.

sourceObject.name: Necrotic Affinity
sourceObject.description: Death's chill is an old friend on Aethel's battlefields—you channel grave-cold through fist and focus without flinching, as if the Binding left a door ajar in your marrow. Prestige lineage: Gravetouched. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You have resistance to necrotic damage. Once per turn when you hit with a melee attack, you can deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage. When you take necrotic damage from a spell or supernatural effect, you can use your reaction to absorb half of it (rounded down) and add that amount as temporary hit points until the end of your next turn. Creatures you kill with necrotic damage cannot be raised by effects of 5th level or lower for 24 hours.

sourceObject.name: Soul Cage
sourceObject.description: You trap the departing in black crystal—voices pressed flat until you need their scream. Prestige lineage: Soulrender. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: When a hostile creature dies within 30 feet, you may bind its soul to a black crystal, storing up to 3 soul charges. Spend 1 charge to shield an ally for 2d8 temporary HP, or spend 2 charges to fire an Agony Lance (3d8 necrotic, save for half, and the target has disadvantage on the next healing it receives).

sourceObject.name: Lifeleech
sourceObject.description: Your magic does not merely harm—it siphons the vigor that death has not yet claimed. Prestige lineage: Soulrender. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: When you deal necrotic damage with a spell, you regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. When a hostile creature dies within 30 feet, you absorb a soul spark, gaining 1 soul charge (max 3). Soul charges can power Soul Cage abilities.
